attackers_goals: Attackers aim to get persistence to continue operating even after a reboot.
description: Execution of an uncommon process with a local/domain user SID at an early startup stage may be an indication of a persistent mechanism on boot that is being actively abused.
investigative_actions: Check if the CGO (causality group owner) is familiar and if any configuration, parameters, or registry keys have been modified.
